steps.title: This is you
steps.text: You play Ruth: the gold YOU tag over her head and on her picture at the top says so. The camera follows her. Everyone else has a mind of their own.

steps.title: Walk
steps.text: W A S D walk Ruth, and the camera goes with her. Take a few steps around the yard. The walls keep the dead out, and keep you in.
steps.goal: walk six steps with W A S D

steps.title: Aim and shoot
steps.text: A walker is coming to the north wall. Shots stop at its face, so climb the marked ladder to the walkway. Then hold the right mouse button to aim, and click to shoot.
steps.text_always: A walker is coming to the north wall. Shots stop at its face, so climb the marked ladder to the walkway. Then aim with the mouse and hold the left button.
steps.goal: climb the ladder to the walkway

goals.text: hold the right mouse button to aim at the walker

goals_always.text: aim at the walker, hold the left button

steps.title: Reload and swing
steps.text: The gun holds a few rounds: R reloads it, and the readout under the clock shows the magazine over the stores. When something gets close, F swings the butt.

steps.title: Who is who
steps.text: Everyone else has a job, a mood and a say. Click Dez's picture at the top: his panel shows his work, his skills, and how far he trusts you.
steps.goal: click Dez's picture at the top

steps.title: Ask, do not order
steps.text: Nobody takes orders: you ask, over the radio. With Dez picked, press Come with me. He answers, then follows you. Go back sends him back to work.

steps.title: A refusal
steps.text: Ana is bandaging Walt, so she can't come. Ask her anyway: the reason shows. Insist pushes her to come regardless, at a cost to her trust.
steps.goal: click Ana, then press Come with me

steps.title: News and calls
steps.text: T opens News, the radio's log. Some news waits for your answer: a wall is under attack, and the radio asks what to do. Answer it, or the default answer is taken.
steps.goal: press T to open the News

goals.text: answer the call: pick one of the buttons

steps.title: The map
steps.text: G opens the Town Board: the map of the town. Pick a place to see what it holds and how far it is. Take control plays a trip yourself, in the real game: not today.
steps.goal: press G, pick a place, then close it

goals.text: pick a place, then close the board with G

steps.dialog_text: Pick a place on the map, then press G or Close.

steps.title: The alarm
steps.text: When the dead are at the wall, ring the alarm: L, or the Alarm button. Everyone drops what they are doing and goes to their post. Press it again to stand down.
steps.goal: press L to ring the alarm

goals.text: press L again to stand down

steps.title: Dusk
steps.text: The bell rings at 19:00 and the dead come, a few more each night. Everyone goes to their post. Shots cost ammo: watch the Ammo store. Walls cost scrap to mend.
steps.goal: watch the Ammo number go down
steps.wait_text: Marcus says how many are coming at 17:00: it shows in the clock. The bell rings at 19:00. Press 3 to hurry the day along.

steps.title: The duty roster
steps.text: Between your requests, everyone does a job: at a station by day, at a post on the wall by night. Press J, or click the clipboard, to open the Duty roster.
steps.goal: press J to open the Duty roster

goals.text: close the page with J or the Close button
goals.line: Now close the page: press J or Close.

goals.text: give someone a job, or press Auto-assign
goals.line: Give someone a job, or press Auto-assign.

steps.wait_text: Hold the wall until first light at 06:30. The dead drift away then. Press 3 to hurry the night along.

steps.title: Well done
steps.text: You can walk, shoot, ask the crew over the radio, answer the News, read the map, ring the alarm and set the roster. The ? button lists every key. Ready for thirty nights?
steps.skipped_text: No problem. The ? button lists every key, and you can play Orientation Day again from the main menu whenever you like.
